title: RBI Customer Protection Framework on Unauthorized Electronic Banking Transactions
content: The RBI Customer Protection policy limits customer liability in unauthorized electronic banking transactions. Customers have ZERO liability if an unauthorized transaction occurs due to third-party breach or system deficiency where neither bank nor customer is at fault, provided the customer notifies the bank within 3 working days of receiving communication. If reporting occurs between 4 to 7 working days, customer liability is capped at ₹10,000 to ₹25,000 depending on account type. Banks must credit the disputed amount to the customer within 10 working days of notification.
